name: Muhammad Ganjar Imanudin
title: Back-End Developer
headline: .NET · MongoDB · PostgreSQL
summaryBio: Software developer with 5+ years of experience building scalable web applications, focused on back-end development and always eager to keep growing my back-end skills.

skills.note: Used for repetitive and boilerplate code, and as an assistant to cross-check requirement docs, designs and the actual code. All generated code goes through my own review to meet the project's criteria and quality standards.

descJob: Developed the back-end for RIFTSTORM, a co-op PvE looter-shooter on Steam, using .NET 8 in a team of 3 programmers and collaborating with 10+ roles across the game project.
Implemented player-related data models (e.g., Player Inventory) and persisted them in MongoDB for scalable and structured storage.
Researched, tested, and implemented MongoDB Sharding to support distributed multi-region data, ensuring optimal data locality and performance.
Refactored and enhanced Hangfire job system, introducing job tagging and account-based filtering for improved traceability and debugging.
Reduced background job load on the main back-end by modularizing Hangfire into a standalone project, improving scalability and configuration flexibility.
Integrated Sentry for application monitoring, utilizing custom issue and transaction tagging to enable faster and more accurate diagnostics.
Delivered a production-ready game server capable of supporting 1,000+ players during Steam Next Fest in June 2025.
Built CI/CD pipelines to containerize the server app and generate compose scripts, enabling game programmers to test back-end integration independently.
Worked on multiple projects for clients across different sectors.
Developed the back-end of a fantasy football game for a video-streaming platform client, covering team building, contests, match-based scoring and leaderboards.
Focused on integrating with external systems and providing data to the front-end.
Worked primarily with .NET 8, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL.
Developed the admin dashboard and back-end for Levio, Agate's gamified learning platform for corporate clients, using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL and Firebase in a team of 5 developers.
Developed REST APIs for communication between the back-end and front-end using Grape (a Ruby API framework).
Maintained the platform for 5 client tenants.
Enhanced front-end features of an omnichannel contact center platform for enterprise and government clients, using PHP with the Phalcon framework.
Connected the interface to back-end services, fetching data and displaying it in pages and dashboards.
Built consistent, responsive layouts with Bootstrap.

portfolio.title: RIFTSTORM
portfolio.summary: Co-op PvE looter-shooter ARPG for PC, now in Steam Early Access. I built back-end services in .NET 8 and MongoDB that kept the game stable for 1,000+ players during Steam Next Fest in June 2025.
details: Player data models such as inventory, persisted in MongoDB.
MongoDB sharding for multi-region data locality and performance.
Hangfire background jobs moved into a standalone service, with job tagging and account-based filtering.
Sentry monitoring with custom issue and transaction tags for faster diagnostics.
CI/CD pipelines that containerize the server, so game programmers can test back-end integration on their own.

portfolio.title: Fantasy Football Game (B2B)
portfolio.summary: Skill-based fantasy football game inside a video-streaming app, played alongside live league broadcasts. I built the back-end for team building, contests, match scoring and leaderboards.
details: Users built a team on a fixed credit budget for each match and entered contests.
Match-based scoring and season-long leaderboards with rank-based prize tiers.
Hangfire background jobs for processing match results and verifying final standings.
Built for a B2B client; the game and client stay unnamed under NDA.

portfolio.title: Levio
portfolio.summary: Gamified learning app for Android and iOS from Agate Level Up, used by companies for employee training. I developed the admin dashboard and back-end, and maintained the platform for 5 client tenants.
details: Learners' avatars level up and evolve with experience points earned from missions and courses.
Admin dashboard and back-end built with Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, with Firebase.
REST APIs for the mobile app built with Grape.
One platform serving 5 corporate client tenants, each maintained and supported over time.

portfolio.title: Omnichannel Contact Center Platform
portfolio.summary: Enterprise and government platform that brings customer conversations from multiple channels into one place, with ticketing, reports and dashboards. As a front-end intern I enhanced features and connected the interface to back-end data.
details: Built and enhanced front-end features with PHP and the Phalcon framework.
Fetched data from back-end services and displayed it in pages and dashboards.
Used Bootstrap for consistent, responsive layouts.
